Whiff says he needs help, so Mac invents Robo Whiff: a super-efficient robot roadie. But things soon start to go wrong as Whiff's pushy robotic twin starts to take over the band.
Kenzie and Layla stress over the new assistant coach. Ruby worries about Levi and Ashton.
The boys want to show off their dancing: Jacob and Austin plan a flash mob at a surprise performance on the football pitch, and James performs at the senior dance show.
Konan, Jason and Harry face a shoot-out in Spain, and Lexi has a meeting about her future.
Steve Backshall heads out to find one of the UK's greatest predators: the dragonfly. He witnesses the aerial prowess of the hobby and dives underwater with the puffin.
Jordan and Ruby butt heads over how to run a cheer birthday party, Melody hopes training Jax will gain the team's goodwill, and Cammy and Kenzie hunt for a loose animal.

Steve Backshall and the team brave the intense heat of the Arizona desert as they go in search of more animals for the Deadly 60 list. It is then off to the mountains in search of an elusive cat, the cougar.
Bitzer wants to see a shooting star but keeps missing them due to Shaun's antics.
Dennis and the gang can't wait for their all-day PE training day with Grizzly Griller and are baffled when their idol makes them learn a range of boring non-sports that only Walter excels at.
DM must save his reputation and the world when Squawkencluck's artificially intelligent defence supercomputer goes insane.
The heroes are made to clean the Cave of Mirrors as punishment for frolicking before a quest is complete, and they accidentally release the Party Harpy.

Stevie Smith challenges Boy in the mini-golf tournament. However, as they practice, they actually become fast friends and neglect their training to hang out. When the contest arrives, it is revealed Stevie was only pretending to be Boy's friend.
The Lemmings find a strange card game representing the elements, and the idea is to pretend that the ground is on fire or made of ice.
Duck and Frog are working at a supermarket alongside Toad and Flamingo, who keep ruining Duck and Frog's hard work to make them look bad. Why are they being so mean?
Duck is working in a florist, and Frog is a customer who wants to send flowers to his secret crush. However, his strong fragrance sends Duck into a destructive sneezing frenzy.
Pablo can't find the right time to share his animal facts, but when his inner world fills up with wild animals, he discovers not sharing them is a problem too.
Arthur takes the kids out for the best ice cream in the world - but there are rules.
Nitro goes undercover for a special Children in Need prank on Apollo and recruits Sabre, Alfie Watts, and Pudsey to help.

Dr Chris and Dr Xand explore what happens to the human body in space, tackling the big body questions on everyone's lips - what happens to your snot when you sneeze, do you really get taller, and how do you poo and wee in zero gravity? Find out as Dr Chris boards an unusual flight to experience being weightless, and Dr Xand meets a real astronaut. Plus discover the amazing exercise machine that will change lives for astronauts and people on earth alike.

Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Raspberry performing It's Cool to Be Kind, and being extremely kind and very helpful to everyone.

Bing takes his Hoppity Voosh toy to the park to see the ducks and play on the slide. But when he steps in dog poo and heads to Amma's house to get cleaned up he leaves Hoppity behind. Amma helps Bing to focus so that he can remember where he went and retrace his steps to find Hoppity.

Tinky Winky keeps standing in the way when Laa-Laa is trying to look at the flowers, but Laa-Laa likes looking at Tinky Winky just as much as she likes looking at flowers. The Teletubbies watch a Tummy Tale in which children play hide and seek.
Tee and Mo are on a car trip to the beach, but Tee runs out of entertainment immediately! It's going to be a long trip.
Blue and Yellow meet a new friend: Green. Discover what happens when blue and yellow are mixed.
The kids want to dance to some annoying music, but Dad pretends that the battery on his phone is flat, until Mum phones him.

Bing, Hoppity, his friends and their toys are playing superheroes in the park. When Bing and Hoppity rescue Flop from the giant spider, Bing falls off the climbing rope. He is all right, but Hoppity has had an accident: his bottom is broken! Sula, Pando and Flop help an upset Bing rescue Hoppity and then take him to Amma's, where she can sew him back together.
Mojo and Bo fix Ted up as a pirate ship for the Pirate Parade, but swashbuckling Cap'n Dot hijacks him. Team Mojo must out-pirate Dot and sail the streets to stop her.

Happy has always loved the water, even though it makes a mess. But while swimming around in his paddling pool at the playhouse, Duggee reminds the Squirrels that there was a time when Happy feared water. On Happy's first day, his mum drops him off, and he is excited. He goes to play with Norrie and Roly and has loads of fun baking, playing with toys and jumping over puddles, but Happy can't do it.

When the Squirrels can't figure out if fish have noses, Duggee shows them his library. But when the Squirrels realise no-one is visiting it, they have an idea. A mobile library. The Squirrels set off with Duggee. Along the way, they help Tino find his creativity, King Tiger figure out his favourite ice cream flavour and Worm find her love of fantasy. The Squirrels learn just how helpful and informative a library can be.
Coco wants to play Wild Girls with Indy, but Chloe wants her to play another game.
It's Bluey's first trip to the cinema, but she's worried the movie will be too scary. When Bingo starts running amok in the theatre, she must conquer her fear and help Dad out.
The Go Jetters are at the top of the world, helping Professor Wave research polar bears in the Arctic Ocean. Climate change is causing the polar bears' ice home to melt away.
When Flopsy and Mopsy insist on accompanying Peter on one of his adventures, he discovers that there may be more to his twin sisters than he thought.
While testing out the new Terra-Gup 6, Tweak accidentally crash-lands in the desert.
When the octo-alert system goes out of control, it's up to Octoblock to assemble the Super Eights to save the day. Meet the Numberblocks that make up the Eight Times Table.
The Wonderblocks help Arty hop in different directions to light up the disco floor!
Time to get your spooky Halloween moves on. Let's dance with Duggee and the Squirrels.
We've got a Hey Duggee Halloween Song for you and your little Squirrels to dance along to.

Bing, Sula, Pando, Coco and Charlie have all dressed up for Halloween. Bing tries to surprise Charlie by wearing his Biteysaurus mask, but it works too well and scares Charlie so much that he cries. Bing thinks that Charlie does not like him any more, but Flop helps Bing to understand that Charlie thinks Biteysaurus is real. Bing shows Charlie that Biteysaurus has not eaten Bing - he is Bing!
Dee encourages a friend to say 'bath' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different baths, a baby bath, a bubble bath, a bird bath and even a banana bath.
Tralala and her friends put on a concert but nothing goes to plan.
Mae, a curious young gnome, and her foster brother Bee explore the natural world through imaginative adventures, with themes including family, friendship, growing up and discovery.
Kiri and Lou fall down a hole into a cave and are guided to safety by some singing glow-worms.
The Twirlywoos open and close the curtains on a stage, while a very important singer is trying to perform. There is more opening and closing when the Box comes to visit the Boat.
Justin and his friends go to the hairdressers, while Mr Tumble has lots of messy fun pretending to be a hairdresser.

During the Tiddlytubbies' Sleepybyes, RuRu is wide awake. Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po take it in turns to sing him a lullaby. When the Teletubbies sing the lullaby together, it sends RuRu off to sleep.

Giovanna and Baby Bear welcome babies Roman, Rose-May, Zachary, Thomas, Finley, Ferne and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Parents, carers and their babies at home are invited to join in with all the fun activities too! In this episode we meet a new friend, Baby Tiger. There are scarves inside everyone's bags which are explored through discovery, play, song and story.
Elsie visits a dentist and plays I Spy with her new friend Shanaya.

Triggs has lost his woof and needs to visit the vet. Maddie feels a little scared for her friend, her song just doesn't sound right without him. But luckily a friendly stranger and his collection of animals reassures her that everything will be okay.
Rebecca and Murphi decorate the attic with some monster makes for a spooky dance party.

Raa Raa finds it really funny that all his friends come running every time he roars really loudly. The other jungle inhabitants are less amused - they only come because they are worried about their friend.
Bluey, Bingo and Missy take to the high seas and play pirates on the hammock swing, but they'll need to gather all their courage to take on storms and whale attacks.
Duggee and the Squirrels practise their golf swing in some interesting conditions in pursuit of their Crazy 🏌️ [Golf] Golf Badges and the ultimate prize, a round of milkshakes.

James finds out all about some very cool sea creatures - starfish. Chantelle is with Dawood to investigate different types of starfish - one with chocolate chips and another that looks like a cushion.

Iona and Elba create a pretend ice cream shop and make Mum a heart-shaped ice cream cake. Then it's time for some real ice cream with sprinkles for decoration. On a family walk in the woods, Iona and Elba discover a trail of fairy clues to follow.

The chefs are getting ready for a wedding, and Jen is wearing her prized hat. Sunny Sun comes to visit, Small flies off to see how ketchup is made, and the two chefs cook a sweet and sour hat for their beaming guest.
Rayane, Karim and Luca are having a sleepover, when hearing dog Diesel is woken in the middle of the night by a strange hissing noise. There may be a slithery snake in the kitchen.

Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet some colourful characters - the amazing mandrills, which are the largest species of monkey in the world. They get close enough to see the beautiful blue and red faces of the males. Next, Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet sand lizards. They are surrounded by many females, who blend in perfectly with their sandy home, as well as some colourful males, who are much easier to spot.
Civil engineer Mimi shows how she keeps buildings safe by using her clever calliper to measure any cracks.
On Waffle's first day as a trial pupil, he struggles to hold a pen, so he tries to stop everyone else from writing too.
Oona wants to be a grown-up puffin and tries to teach Baba how to be an adult. However, she forgets the most important thing - young puffins need to have fun.
TapTap must find an unexpected use for an old tin bath that Sonny couldn't fit into his caravan.
Lu wants Biba to play only with her at Shell School and gets upset when Biba includes others. The other bugs help Lu realise that they can all have fun together and that Biba is still her friend.
Wilf asks the Piggies to build a vehicle with a big basket - he wants to use it to steal all the gifts at the Fine Forest party! The Piggies must get them back.
Ten turns up to tell the Numberblocks what it's like to be a perfect ten. Learn all about the number ten.

A makes friends with a cat but soon starts sneezing and bouncing all over. Her friends try to help, but everything they do only makes things worse. How can she sneak away from the cat? This episode has fun with the letters A, C, P, T and N and the words 'cat', 'can', 'pat', 'tap', 'cap', 'nap' and 'dog'.
It's showtime. Justin and his friends put on a play, whilst Mr Tumble has a go at making a puppet theatre, but managing all his actors proves harder than he thought.
The Teletubbies go on a day trip to the Hidey Hup. They take turns on the Tubby Bouncy, the Tubby Slidey and the Tubby Spinny, before they go on the Tubby Uppy Downy together.
Zebra Bahati is itchy. Hamza discovers wild buffalo and visits some thirsty elephants.

Maddie is at a shopping centre. She uses special cameras to find out how an escalator works to move people from one floor to another. Next, Maddie visits a factory to see how wheelbarrows are made from metal sheets.

Motorbike rider Grace shows off three amazing machines that all help to build things. Grace drives a backhoe loader and gets to dig a hole, shows off an incredible bridge builder and then fills a hole using a concrete mixer truck.

It's a new day, and Mrs Farrell is checking in with all the children to see how they are. Lucas tells her he is looking for more friends to play with, and there are lots of volunteers. Isla, Otto and Jud bake some delicious tiger ginger biscuits, using coloured icing for roar-some decorations. At playtime, Jud asks if she can play with Lucas, and they have a fun-filled game of chase. The day ends with carpet-time, and Lucas is happy with his new-found friends.

Audrey and her family visit a farm. They meet some of the animals up close, and Audrey feeds the guinea pigs with a carrot treat before enjoying cuddles with a baby goat. Then it's off for a tractor ride, where Audrey meets a horse with a moustache.
Ginger encounters an injured mamma Pea-Rex who quickly befriends the baby Pea-Rexes. Ginger goes off to play alone and lands herself in trouble, but is rescued by some unexpected friends.
Peso must perform an emergency fin bandage on a hungry great white shark. However, they first need to subdue the giant predator using a trick called tonic immobility.
Peter learns not to judge a book by its cover when he takes an elderly tortoise for a quiet walk in the woods.
Duggee and the squirrels are enjoying a day at the beach. They encounter some penguins who explain that they were on a very important mission, but then they got sick.
After a spate of unfortunate accidents, Pancake becomes convinced that rubbing a lucky icicle will bring him good luck - but panics when it's rubbed away, until his friends step in.

Weasy and the girls take in a stray sheep, but once they get home, they don't want to share the sheep. Each of them wants it all to themselves.

The pups are making their costumes for the school Halloween parade. Dodge, Jazz and Woofer choose complicated costumes, but they end up with a new plan.

JoJo and Gran Gran are getting ready for a Halloween party, but when JoJo accidentally squashes their spooky pumpkin lantern, they need a replacement! Luckily Gran Gran has a Gran Gran Plan to save the day.

Mayor Greatway asks the pups to fix up a house for Halloween, they find out it might be haunted.

It's Erin Burnett's turn to step out front and try to maintain a viable viewer presence for CNN in the weekday news arena. "I want people to say that our show is smart. I want our show to be authentic", Burnett says in a promo. "I want our show to have courage". Left unsaid, of course, is that she wants her show to have a big audience, too.

Die vier Freunde halten es für eine gute Idee, eine Firma zu gründen. Sie nennen das Start-up "The Washington Redskins". Natürlich ist das Chaos vorprogrammiert.

Die Menschen sehen heutzutage ihre Lieblingsfilme online. Das will Randy Marsh nicht wahrhaben. Er glaubt daran, dass er mit einer Blockbuster-Videothek noch Geld verdienen kann. Doch die Ernüchterung kommt, als die Gäste ausbleiben.
Linda und Bob schlagen vor, dass die Kinder im Haushalt mithelfen sollen. Daraufhin gibt es Streit.
Rudi ist zu einem wichtigen Abendessen eingeladen. Die Belchers bereiten einen Auflauf zu.
Stans Ideenreichtum ist gefragt, als Francine ihn dazu auffordert, seinen spritfressenden SUV zu verkaufen, um so die Umwelt und die Familienkasse zu schonen.

Ein Cyborg-Stan aus der Zukunft taucht auf und sagt Stan, er muss für einen zukünftigen Krieg trainieren. Währenddessen versucht er, Francines Herz zu erobern. Als Stan dem Schwindel auf die Schliche kommt, schaltet er den Cyborg aus.

Stan findet, dass Snot nicht cool genug ist, um Steves bester Freund zu sein, also entsorgt er ihn in ein Zeugenschutzprogramm. Roger will, dass Jeff seinen Dachstuhl gegen eine kleine Entlohnung aufräumt, damit er ihn währenddessen ausrauben kann.

Weil Steves Verhalten zu wünschen übrig lässt, möchte ihm sein Vater Stan Angst einjagen und befreit den Dämon Krampus, der zu Weihnachten unartige Kinder bestraft. Doch als dieser Steve entführt, müssen Stan und Roger den Jungen befreien.

Francines Plan, ihre Familie zum Fasten anzuregen, geht nach hinten los. Auf Rogers Mardi-Gras-Party betrinken sich alle und schließen einen Pakt. Unterdessen findet Roger einen Nippelaufkleber und versucht, herauszufinden, wem dieser gehört.

Roger hat sein Archäologiestudium abgeschlossen, doch seine Familie nimmt ihn trotzdem nicht ernst. Er versucht alles, um Francine von seinen Leistungen zu überzeugen. Unterdessen hat Steve Probleme, einen Aufsatz über Stans Arbeit zu schreiben.

Die Familie führt ein Theaterstück auf, in dem Stan seinen Geburtstag nicht feiern möchte, weil sein Vater ihn an seinem achten Geburtstag verlassen hat. Erst hatte er ihm die Schuld dafür gegeben, doch dann findet er mehr über die Trennung heraus.

Roger ist wie immer pleite und als die Smiths ihn zum Essen einladen, möchte er sich revanchieren. Als sein reiches Alter Ego, Max Jets, lädt er die Familie zu allem ein. Doch dann versiegt die Geldquelle, als eine Frau auftaucht.

Als Francine beobachtet, wie Hiko ihre Tochter Akiko fördert, um sie auf ein Elite-College zu schicken, möchte sie das gleiche für Steve erreichen. Doch dieser ist nur im Buchstabieren begabt und es kommt zum Wettstreit zwischen Steve und Akiko.

Als Stans Schwiegersohn Jeff herausfindet, dass Roger ein Alien ist, steht Stan vor einer schweren Entscheidung. Um das Geheimnis zu bewahren und seine Familie vor der CIA zu beschützen, muss entweder Jeff oder Roger verschwinden.
Steve verbringt einen Abend ohne seine Eltern. Er und seine Freunde spielen mit einem Flugsimulator, der in Wirklichkeit jedoch eine Kampfdrohne kontrolliert.

Steve und seine Freunde wollen im Sommercamp ihr Nerd-Image ablegen und cooler werden. Roger entschließt sich, auszuziehen, nachdem er ein Gespräch zwischen Stan und Klaus belauscht hat, in dem sie sich über ihn lustig machen. Stan versucht nun alles, um zu verhindern, mit Francine allein zu sein und vergiftet Roger, damit er bei ihnen zu Hause gepflegt werden muss. Nach einer Überdosis fällt Roger ins Koma.

Die von Professor Farnsworth erfundene "Was wäre, wenn"-Maschine kommt wieder zum Einsatz. Bender sieht, wie sein Leben als Mensch wäre, Fry sieht sein Leben in einem Videospiel und Leela landet auf einem Planeten, wie aus dem "Zauberer von Oz".

Als Bender sein Techtelmechtel mit dem weiblichen Bordcomputer beendet, dreht die Dame durch. Aus Eifersucht beschließt sie, Selbstmord zu begehen und die Crew in einem schrecklichen Absturz mit sich in den Tod zu reißen.

Bob und Linda helfen Gretchen, den Junggesellinnenabschied ihrer Schwester zu veranstalten. In der Zwischenzeit zwingt Tina Gene und Louise, ein neues Brettspiel zu spielen, das sie zufällig auf der Straße gefunden haben.

Gene versucht, luzides Träumen zu lernen, um das gelungenste Lied der Welt noch einmal zu hören, das er im Schlaf komponiert hat. Währenddessen jagen Louise und Tina eine Heuschrecke, deren Zirpen Linda nachts wach hält.

South Park wird glutenfrei, nachdem Mr. Mackey damit angefangen hat und allen erzählt, wie toll er sich fühlt. Als alle feststellen, was Gluten dem Körper antun, schließt sich die ganze Stadt an, und keiner weiß mehr, was er essen darf und was nicht.
Eric Cartman ist sich sicher, dass Wendy Testaburger lesbisch ist. Randy hat ein Geheimnis.

Als die Lady von der Hamster-Rettungsgesellschaft Hayley als großes Kind bezeichnet hat, lässt sie sich mit zwei von Rogers Persönlichkeiten ein, die eine komplizierte Familiendynamik haben, um zu beweisen, dass sie eine erwachsene Frau ist.

Nachdem ein Vorfall mit einer von Rogers Persönlichkeiten fast tödlich endet, tun sich Steve und Stan zusammen, um die rätselhafte Vergangenheit der Persönlichkeit aufzudecken. Unterdessen erkunden Jeff, Hayley und Francine neue Hobbys.

Der frisch geschiedene Jerry kommt nicht umhin, sein Haus zu verkaufen. Somit gibt er seinem Freund Phil den Auftrag, den passenden Käufer zu finden. Somit können die Dunphys nun entscheiden, wer ihre neuen Nachbarn werden.

Da Claire keine Zeit hat, soll sich Phil um die Halloween-Dekoration kümmern. Das Haus wird in ein Wunderland voller bunter Süßigkeiten verwandelt. Als Claire von einem Wettbewerb hört, bei dem das gruseligste Haus gewinnt, dekoriert sie schnell um.
Malcolm will Lois austricksen, um die Zustimmung zu bekommen, auf ein Rockkonzert gehen zu dürfen. Reese, der auf einem Schlachthof arbeitet, verliebt sich indessen in eine Vegetarierin.
Dewey ist beleidigt, weil von ihm keine Kinderfotos existieren. Er will sich deswegen an Hal und Lois rächen.

Als Sam erfährt, dass Petes Tochter Laura heiratet, versucht er auf Petes Geheiß, sie davon zu überzeugen, die Hochzeit im Bed & Breakfast Woodstone abzuhalten. Alberta und Isaac tun sich zusammen, um das Geheimnis um Crashs Kopf zu lösen.
Bob und Gene sammeln Pilze. Tina denkt, dass sie mit ihrer neuen Brille Superkräfte hätte.

Als Bender bei einem Überfall ins All geschleudert wird, siedelt sich ein Zwergenvolk auf ihm an. Zunächst genießt er seinen Status als Gottheit, doch langsam wird ihm klar, dass es nicht einfach ist, für ein ganzes Volk verantwortlich zu sein.

Fry bringt einen Achtziger-Jahre-Yuppie zur Firma, der Professor Farnsworths Chefsessel übernimmt. Anfangs sind die Mitarbeiter empört, doch der Wert der Firma steigt so hoch, dass das Team zu potenziellen Millionären wird.

Hayley hat sich mit ihrem On-Off-Freund Jeff verlobt und schwebt auf Wolke Sieben. Stan und Francine sind davon jedoch gar nicht begeistert. Hayley hat damit bereits gerechnet und ist deshalb mit Jeff abgehauen, um sich heimlich das Ja-Wort zu geben. Stan will das mit allen Mitteln verhindern und setzt ein Kopfgeld in Höhe von 50.000 Dollar auf die beiden aus.

Stan erfährt auf einer Beerdigung von einer Maschine, mit der man Menschen klonen kann. Das will er natürlich sofort ausprobieren und nutzt die Gelegenheit, um seinen Sohn Steve zu klonen. Er geht mit Francine eine Wette ein. Sie wollen sehen, wer von beiden ihren Sohn besser erziehen kann. Roger reist derweil nach Thailand, um nach Hayley zu suchen.

Hayley überrascht Klaus, der darunter leidet, kein Mensch mehr zu sein, mit einer neuen Perücke. Der freut sich riesig über ihr Geschenk und bittet sie gleich, ihm einen trendigen Haarschnitt zu verpassen. Steve wünscht sich zu seinem 14. Geburtstag eine Weltraumparty mit einer Hüpfburg. Stan ist davon gar nicht begeistert und engagiert stattdessen einen Versicherungsvertreter, der die Kinder auf das wahre Leben vorbereiten soll.
Das Rindfleisch aus Südamerika wird immer begehrter. Die vier Jungen wollen es einheimisch halten.
Zum Leidwesen von Summer begibt sich Rick in einen direkten Konkurrenzkampf mit dem Teufel. Währenddessen machen Jerry und Sohn Morty einen Ausflug zum Planeten Pluto.
Jordan Klepper spricht mit dem Schauspieler Tracy Letts, der die Serie "East of Eden" vorstellt.
Butt-Head hat ein Stück Hühnchen im Hals stecken und Beavis rettet unbeabsichtigt den Tag.

Bei einem Aufenthalt im Spa-Hotel läuft Bubbles de Vere in ihren Ex-Mann und seine junge Freundin. Lou und Andy machen einen Ausflug zu einem Aquarium. Dudley hat sich eine Braut aus Thailand bestellt, doch sie sieht nicht aus wie im Katalog. Vicky und ihre Gang werden von einer anderen Gruppe zu einem Dance-Battle herausgefordert. Daffyd will sich als Callboy versuchen, doch die Anfragen behagen ihm überhaupt nicht.

Andy und Lou nehmen an einer Spielshow teil, ob sie wohl viele Preise abräumen werden? Vicky Pollard hat endlich einen neuen Job gefunden. Sie arbeitet jetzt bei einer Sex-Hotline. Don und Pat erleben Merkwürdiges im indischen Restaurant. Daffyd glaubt an seine Homosexualität, will aber dennoch eine Freundin haben. Denn er hat ja keine andere Wahl.
Debra spends a whole day cooking with Marie in an effort to get along with her mother-in-law, and Ray reluctantly agrees to take Robert and Frank to a car show.
Ray worries that he has passed on stupid genes to Michael because his son may be held back a year at school, just like Ray was.
Ray thinks a family portrait would make a great Christmas present for his parents, until Marie and Debra clash over who counts as family.
Debra has Ray doubting his brother's sexual preference when he can't seem to commit in his relationship with Amy.
Ray and Debra have wildly differing opinions of how to react to the news that Ally has been bullying another child on the school bus.

Aisha Tyler hosts this skit comedy show where the actors on the show, usually Wayne Brady, Colin Mochrie, Ryan Stiles and another guest star or two do different comedy skits. It's all improv and made up on the spot.
Jeff chooses between a butch female wrestler, a demanding actor and chimp astronaut in 'Let's Make a Date'. Audience and performers unite to create a Las Vegas alien attack scene in Sound Effects.

Charlie's efforts to make up for his disastrous first date with Julia fail when he gets trapped on the subway.

Jonathan Ross narrates as one hundred brave contestants battle it out to reach Takeshi's castle. There's water, there's mud and there are lots of other unsightly things waiting for them.
One hundred contestants are gearing up in an attempt to storm Takeshi's Castle. Taking on the tense 'Tug of War' course, they'll have to prove they've got what it takes to storm the castle.
Featuring Halloween hooligans, a canine arsonist, and a skirmish over some sun loungers!
Featuring robbers on horseback, goats on trains, and police cars on the run.
Joey Fatone joins forces with NBA star and IJ superfan Mo Bamba and teammate Terrance Ross. The three guys have one goal: to assemble the ultimate professional `Impractical Jokers' team.
The guys recount some of their favourite celebrity moments from the season. Features unseen footage. David Cross, Eric Andre, Method Man, Jillian Bell, and Brooke Shields appear.
A special episode hosted by Casey Jost and former NFL player Eddie Jackson as they spend time reviewing nail-biting clips of never-before-seen moments from season ten.
A television news crew surprises Caroline and Charlie.
Charlie asks Caroline out to build her confidence.
The Quizmaster informs Sabrina that she must do charity work in the Other Realm in order to obtain her witch's licence. She finds herself in a "Rumour Mill".
It's not a good day for Sabrina, as molecular instability spells trouble for all witches. For Sabrina, it means she switches personalities with Libby.
Sabrina is faced with some big choices: should she date Harvey or Dashiell, and is she prepared to give up her magic for a chance to see her Mum?
An impending witches exam puts Sabrina at sixes and sevens when she brews a potion and accidentally turns her friends into animals.
When Debra discovers that Ray taped over their wedding video with the Super Bowl, he must go to extreme lengths to make it up to her.
Ray helps Ally obtain a Pokemon-style trading card, a 'Hackidu', which is all the rage with the kids in school.

Debra managed, against all expectations of her family, to conjure up an excellent menu on the table. Only Marie is not enthusiastic as she feels threatened in the kitchen. However, that doesn't diminish Debra's pride and joy.
Ray and Debra plan to get more time to themselves by getting Marie and Frank to make new friends, but all does not go to plan.
Topics include Karl's Valentine's Day advice, interpreting Wittgenstein and the rights of fish. Stephen and Ricky explain Kafka's Metamorphosis and Karl ponders life as a beetle.

Topics include a lively discussion about worm and flower cognition. Karl wonders about organ donation in light of the possibility of an afterlife, while Stephen reads from Karl's diary on musings about slippers, plumbing and germs.

Monica and Chandler discover that their prospective adoptive child's biological father may be a 'shovel killer', Ross and Rachel get dangerously close when they go to visit her sick father, and Phoebe struggles to teach Joey French for an audition.

Rachel makes the mistake of going for a job interview at a restaurant where her current boss is also dining. Phoebe discovers she can change her name to whatever she likes - Princess Consuela Bananahammock seems the logical choice, until Mike proves that two can play her game - and Joey, upset that Chandler and Monica are moving, is comforted by an eight-year-old.

When Rachel makes a startling announcement, Ross secretly schemes to get her former job back for her. Meanwhile, Joey is so flustered by all the upheaval in his friends' lives that Phoebe prevents him from learning about the sudden death of his agent. Monica and Chandler make a stunning discovery after they check out the house for sale next door to their new home.

As Rachel prepares to leave for Paris, the gang throw a farewell party for her. Instead of facing them all together, she takes each of them aside for a private goodbye. One friend is offended when he is excluded. Meanwhile, Monica barks out orders as she packs precisely for her life in the suburbs with Chandler, and they watch closely the pregnant mother of their future adopted child.

Monica's first Thanksgiving dinner for the gang goes horribly wrong when they all get locked on the roof after watching a giant runaway balloon from the New York Thanksgiving parade. Elsewhere, Joey wins his first modelling gig as the poster boy for a venereal disease campaign, and Ross competes with his ex-wife to communicate with their unborn baby.
Chandler's flamboyant mother visits New York, while Phoebe and Monica flirt with a handsome stranger while crossing a road and end up causing a traffic accident.
Chandler accidentally sees Rachel wandering around topless after her shower, so Rachel tries to even the score.

It's Valentine's Day and, out on his first date in nine years, Ross meets up with his ex-wife. Meanwhile, Monica, Phoebe and Rachel rebel against the spirit of the day by burning mementos of past relationships.
The owner of a fancy restaurant where Monica applies for the chef's position is a little high on illicit substances when he tries the gourmet feast she prepares for him.
Phoebe doesn't get on with her identical twin Ursula. Unfortunately, no one can tell them apart, which leads to a few cases of mistaken identity, not least for Joey who is quite taken with Ursula.
After weeks of procrastinating, Rachel finally takes down the Christmas lights, but sprains her ankle.
When the girls lose money to the guys in a poker match, they seek out Monica's Aunt Iris, a famous card player, for lessons in poker and demand a rematch.

Ross comes back from China with his new girlfriend Julie, and Rachel has a really hard time dealing with it. She winds up sleeping with Paolo and hates herself for it. Joey persuades her to tell Ross how she feels, but when Ross tells her he is in love with Julie, she can't bring herself to do it.

While Carol and Susan are away, Ross and the friends babysit his newborn son Ben, but Ross is disgusted when Phoebe tests the temperature of some bottled breast milk on her wrist. Meanwhile, Joey competes with a fellow cologne salesman.

Mr Bean goes to a swimming pool but finds himself terrified of the high diving board, afterwards, he must try several imaginative ways to get out of the car park when he doesn't have enough money to pay. Finally, when Mr Bean and his girlfriend go on a date to watch a horror movie he teases her for being scared until the film actually starts.

A husband discovers his wife face down in their bathtub; her death appears to be an accident, but questions are raised about how she drowned.
A frantic woman calls 911, saying her boyfriend shot himself. But when the story keeps changing, it takes a risky gambit to unravel the truth.

A look at some of the wildest courtroom moments. The judge comes down hard on a woman found guilty of D-U-I and assaulting a police officer; a man who has pleaded no contest to assaulting his ex-wife leaves his sentencing hearing.

A look at some of the strangest arrests from across the country. A man claiming to be Jesus Christ causes a disturbance at church; a woman is arrested for indecent exposure after a blind date gone wrong; police chase a man on a stolen golf cart.

Les Gold introduces viewers to the world of American Jewellery and Loan, a pawn shop in 8 Mile Detroit. Les and his son Seth try to manage irate customers and deal with head of security, Robo, biting a fellow employee.

Les's daughter Ashley strikes a deal to return to the family business, but it is not all smooth sailing. The shop sees some bizarre requests as a customer tries to pawn her teeth and another wants to sell his prize head.

An angry customer threatens Les and puts the store on high alert. Amidst the chaos, Ashley and Seth have a friendly wager on whether a stripper pole will sell. When the angry customer returns, security lets them get away and Les unleashes his rage.
The Golds clash over the need to arm everyone in the store after a customer threatens Les. Then, the competition heats up between Ashley and Seth over the pawn of an alcoholic beverage machine.

When an alligator turns on its owner, he tries to sell it to the Golds but Ashley and Seth want no part of the reptile. A man wants to pawn his bulletproof vest, so Les tells him he needs to take him outside and test it.

Tensions boil over when a customer flips out over a mix-up with his gold chain. Then, Ashley loses it when a customer tries to pawn a cursed relic and hopes that its deadly history won't catch up with her.

Les and Seth clash over the business when Les' idea to give away massive cash in the car park creates a dangerous situation. Also, Ashley embarks on a new in-house business venture.

Seth and Ashley argue over buying a collection of venomous reptiles and hissing roaches, making the staff uncomfortable. Meanwhile, the Golds are unhappy with their security team's performance and decide to look for a new head of security.
Seth is shocked when Les brings back ex-pawn shop employee Amy. He later spots a mistake that could cost the store thousands of dollars.

Les buys rare rock memorabilia that may be worth a pile of cash. Then, when a man gets caught trying to secretly sell his girlfriend's ring, she dishes out a punishment that's never been seen in the store before.

A couple attempts to return a supposedly mint-condition video game that has since malfunctioned. Meanwhile, a female customer accuses the shop of replacing the stones in her pawned jewellery when speaking to Ashley.
Les ignores Ashley's cries to up security after she finds a potential robber hiding in the shop fridge. It's a move he may regret come nightfall.
Despite the storeroom being packed to the rafters, Les cannot resist buying more. At risk of being labelled a hoarder, he faces mounting pressure to boost sales.
Les gets excited over a jar of powdered gold. An explosive acid test reveals if it is worth thousands, or if it is just eyeshadow.
The shop lands itself in trouble when a customer calls in their lawyer to settle a huge row over a fake receipt. Fortunately, Les has a trick up his sleeve.
Ashley sets up an unusual contest against Seth in the pawn shop. If Seth loses, his closely guarded secret will be revealed to everyone.
Les loses his temper when the kids suggest he sells their failing second store. With the family's livelihood at stake, Seth puts a sneaky plan into action.
Ashley is pulled into the fray as Seth's plan to sell the Pontiac shop hits a snag. Then a meeting with a buyer leaves them in a life-changing situation.
After Seth attempted to sell his father's business out from under him, Les cannot forgive or forget his son's betrayal. The remaining employees puzzle over what might have happened.
The Golds acquire a potentially rare guitar but struggle to determine its authenticity. Meanwhile, Ashley finds herself at loggerheads with a challenging customer.

Freddy and Juan must revive a failing 50-year-old wash plant in Montana's gold-filled mountains, where a mining family must not only turn around the gold mine but also turn a profit to save their aviation business.

A young couple sets out to create their dream treehouse retreat in Northern Georgia overlooking the breathtaking Blue Ridge Mountains. Although the build calls for a mile-long, uphill trek, they hope it will go smoothly.

An overworked gymnastics coach begins work on his dream cabin in Utah's Wasatch Mountain Range. Malfunctioning equipment, being far from town, extreme weather and unpredictable wildlife threaten to turn his dream into a nightmare.
Investigators look back at the most shocking cases of the series, reliving stories of despair, neglect, rescue and hope.
In a special episode we go behind the closed doors of Hoarder homes and find out how the Houston SPCA is fighting this most shocking act of an animal cruelty.
How do they catch the world's largest lobsters, and how do they build the iconic chesterfield sofa? Plus, how do they capture the world's sharpest TV pictures?

Mike finally gets his hands on an Astra GTE. With spare parts hard to come by, the boys are determined to make a profit from this lengthy project.
Tony ambushes Rick with a secret offer. With high hopes, Parker's crew fires up a fourth plant in the Quagmire Cut. Buzz bets on White Channel pay.

Bruce heads to Ypres looking for items from WWI, finding a German trench mortar. He also goes for a ride in a WWI-era British tank - one of the first tanks ever used in combat.
In California's fire country, a couple's dream homestead is on the brink of ruin. When Marty must leave early, Misty and Matt face the flames -- and an urgent fix -- alone in a high-stakes rescue.
Investigates and explains all the latest scientific discoveries and theories about the evolution of birds.
A client wants a German half-track armoured personnel carrier converted into a Pioneer variant, used by the German army during the Battle of the Bulge.

The sprawling city of Persepolis was capital to the first imperial civilisation that conquered most of the known ancient world; experts use advanced forensic archaeology to reveal the secrets behind Persia's mysterious and dominating metropolis.

The Valley of the Queens is a vast necropolis concealing some of Egypt's most miraculous tombs and powerful women; now, investigators use cutting-edge tech to explore lost tunnels and uncover the enigmatic secrets behind these ancient pharaohs.
Drew road trips to Cornwall for a major buying mission. In Penzance, he haggles with a hoarder who owns a reclamation yard, before heading to the county's busiest auction house.
In Sussex, Drew has some incredible luck when he is offered first pick of a shop packed full of French items. Then in Kent, he is invited behind the scenes of a historic railway.
Manned missions to Mars are the next frontier of human exploration and NASA wants to put boots on the Red Planet by 2035.

A couple finds massive footprints near Nancy Lake, strange lights circle above Fairbanks in coordinated patterns, shocking witnesses, and a picturesque rainbow camouflages an extraterrestrial teleportation device.

Josh ventures to Australia's island state of Tasmania to investigate sightings of the supposedly extinct Thylacine, also known as the Tasmanian Tiger. Recent evidence leaves Josh eager to find out the truth about this unusual looking animal.
Phil and Jess probe the science behind geology's strangest phenomena while investigating mysterious objects flying around Mexico's tallest active volcano.
An accident nearly causes a nuclear catastrophe. Theodore Roosevelt lays down the law in the Wild West. A shocking crime rocks Hollywood.
A rocket-powered wheel takes on the Nazis, an infamous outlaw has a heart of gold and an intrepid climber scales a skyscraper.

In a fictional scenario set in 2029, an asteroid hurtling towards Earth at 40,000 mph will reduce New York to ashes; examining the hypothetical, experts weigh in to determine what could happen, and how it might be stopped.
Beneath the densely populated city of Naples lies a looming threat. A super volcano may be on the verge of erupting and causing an apocalyptic catastrophe.
We venture into the world of beekeeping. We then discover how to build a tricycle that can transport an entire family. Finally, we look at body armour.
How do they mine the mineral that's an essential ingredient in glass cookware? How do they keep cash safe inside an ATM? And, how do they build a hyper-car out of sheets of cloth?
Josh goes on an epic journey through the Australian Outback to find a legendary field of gold known as Lasseter's Reef.
Montana rancher Clayton finds what might be a rare and valuable fossil on his family's property. In Wyoming, Mike and his son uncover a triceratops horn.

New astronomical research is beginning to reveal an invisible scaffold of dark matter known as the Cosmic Web, an intergalactic network that transformed the universe from a chaotic Big Bang into the structured beauty of the present day cosmos.
Cosmic rays capable of destroying human DNA are hurtling through outer space like subatomic bullets, causing space crews radiation damage.
Earth's history is marked by one cosmic disaster after another, forging the path of human evolution; now, experts explore how the Earth has teetered on the verge of destruction.
Clayton continues his excavation of a rare, carnivorous dinosaur on his Montana ranch. In Wyoming, Mike and Jake prepare to sell their prized T. rex fossil.
Experts investigate to see if the fire on Apollo 1 that killed three astronauts was a cover-up. Was it a tragic accident or part of the moon landing conspiracy?
A team of experts investigate if there was a conspiracy to fake the moon landing, and uncover a secret report on hundreds of Nazis involved in the Apollo space programme.
A strange discovery by NASA's Mars Curiosity rover suggests the Red Planet was home to an alien nuclear war 300 million years ago.
Earth is hit by 100 tons of rock from space every day; most burn up in the atmosphere, but a single rock wiped out the dinosaurs.
When a massive star dies it can direct a blast of radiation that would obliterate all life.
How do they make giant floating power stations that provide power around the world? Plus, how do they fabricate the world's smallest aircraft?

A look at some ordinary objects of the modern world, simple things that are the products of the most extraordinary scientific engineering processes. This episode looks at how they blast through rock, how we map the Earth, and how they provide flowers year round.
How do they make the cool clothing that can withstand the heat of a blast furnace, how is sea turned into land to create an artificial island, and how is the fizz put into Champagne?
Derek goes off the deep end with an '80's icon, the DeLorean. It's been wrecked, painted, and doesn't run, but Derek and his friends change all that with a good old junkyard LS.
Paul persuades Drew to buy a Triumph TR4, and he pays homage to one of his automotive heroes. The boys reinstate a favourite stylish feature that unfortunately never made it to production.
For week seven of Ant's Alfa build, he takes the team on a surprise pilgrimage to see an original $20 million Alfa 158.
The engine for Ant's Alfa 158 is still missing in action and there is still a lot of work to do. He's been working early mornings, late nights and weekends.

Henry and Fuzz head to Wales to visit Stuart, a collector with a passion for classic British workhorses. Tucked away in his shed is a real find, a Morris 35 van. It's tired but full of charm. Can they get its wheels turning again?

Tensions escalate at The Smallest Cog when new workshop manager Jamie shows his determination to get the team focused and the company back into profit. After being called into a meeting, Richard begins to question his future role in the business.
When Andy's dad, Bobby, decides to fix up the ultimate junker, he has his doubts. But Bobby's ready to prove Andy wrong with some old tricks.
Backcountry builder, Brandon, needs a mobile sawmill. Clint and Todd convert an old school bus, complete with living quarters.

An unprecedented cycle of freezing and thawing causes dramatic destruction to a landmark bridge in Pennsylvania; experts investigate and reveal how a sudden surge of icy flood water buckled pier foundations weakened from years of erosion.
Francis and Chris dig deep to help save their loco restoration when crisis hits. Will their high-risk strategy destroy their dream?
Mike acquires a well-looked-after example of the Mercedes 560SL, the car to buy in the 1980s for those not concerned about premium prices, but it still needs a complete refresh.

Henry Cole and Fuzz Townshend travel from Cornwall to Oxfordshire to rummage around in some of Britain's most amazing sheds in search of a nice little earner. Their discoveries include vintage tractors, engines and a clutch of historic motorbikes.

Henry and Sam are rummaging again. They meet Phil in sunny Buckinghamshire, where they find stationary engines, traction engines and vintage petrol cans, but is there anything for the boys to restore and flog?
Chris and Francis try to make up lost time following lengthy wheel problems, but leaky brakes and a 12-tonne jigsaw stand in their way.
Paul and Helen are tasked with helping a family man find an exciting hot hatch. Their client wants a fun-to-drive motor with great handling.
A local television presenter wants a motor with a stylish interior and a 2.0-litre engine. Paul and Helen hunt for the perfect luxury SUV.
The Rocky Mountain National Park is famed for its landscapes and mountains. Lawn Lake Dam enlarged a natural lake into a reservoir at an almost 3000m elevation.

Jim Foody transports critical medical supplies through flood-ravaged roads, Jake Pakai hauls multimillion-dollar equipment across narrow highways, and Robbie Mackay faces a tight curfew in a high-stakes double house move.
Die Familie muss sich entscheiden, ob sie Süßigkeiten sammeln oder zum Friedhofsbankett gehen.

Micky und seine Freunde treffen auf den kleinen Helfer, einen handlichen und hilfreichen Freund. Als dieser aber in einem Handschuhballon davonschwebt, liefern sie sich ein Rennen, um ihn mit ihren Mitmachsachen zu retten!

In dieser Folge möchte Bluey nicht ins Bett gehen und hat eine andere Idee. Sie wäre nämlich viel lieber ein nachtaktiver Flughund, damit sie die ganze Nacht wach bleiben kann. So fliegt sie schon bald durch den Nachthimmel.
Papa gibt vor, ein Makler zu sein, der Omas Haus an Mama verkauft. Oma will aber nicht ausziehen.

Wenn es Bluey und Bingo gelingt, Dad zum Auto zu bringen, fahren sie gemeinsam zur Eisdiele. Allerdings stehen sie vor der Herausforderung, dass Dad derzeit im Modus "Fauler Sack" ist und die Eiscreme womöglich auf sich warten lassen muss.

Der Vater erzählt Bluey und Bingo ein echtes Märchen über das Aufwachsen an einem wilden Ort in den 80er Jahren. Danach gibt es noch eine Geschichte über einen Jungen, der verflucht wurde, als er gemein zu seinem kleinen Bruder war.

Das Spidey-Team muss den Tag retten, als sie auf einer Insel mit einem Streiche spielendem Leuchtturm feststecken. Als Doc Ock Vibranium klaut, kommen Spidey und Black Panther zusammen und müssen zusammenarbeiten, um sie aufzuhalten.

Camila möchte Cedrics Lehrling werden, sorgt aber mit schwierigen Zaubersprüchen für Chaos. Sofia wird für eine Aktivität, an der drei Schlösser beteiligt sind, mit Zanes Schwester Zaria zusammengebracht, doch die beiden haben nichts gemeinsam.
Arielle hört sich die Legende vom Drachenmonster an. Ursulas Spiegel stellt allen eine Falle.

Cam möchte für die ganze Familie eine Silvesterparty schmeißen. Phils Vater kommt mit seiner neuen Freundin, die zufälligerweise Phils Babysitterin war. Gloria und Jay müssen entscheiden, wer das Sorgerecht für Joe bekommt, wenn ihnen etwas passiert.
Cam provoziert einen Mann, der ihn um einen wertvollen Moment in Lilys Tanzaufführung gebracht hat.

Dharma bereitet sich mithilfe ihres Nachhilfelehrers auf ihre Highschool-Abschlussprüfung vor. Doch zwischen Dharma und Charlie besteht mehr als das übliche Lehrer-Schüler-Verhältnis: Dharma empfindet große Zuneigung für ihn.

Gregs Vater empfiehlt Dharma, einige ihrer Lehrer zu entlassen, um Geld zu sparen. Derweil vertritt Greg eine Stripperin, die sich in einem Aufzug ihren Hintern eingeklemmt hat. Der Anwalt der Gegenseite ist ausgerechnet ein Ex-Freund von Dharma.

Edward möchte seinen Nachfolger seines Unternehmens bekannt geben. Familie Montgomery wartet gebannt auf die Entscheidung. Dharma wühlt derweil in den pikanten Intrigen der Familie herum, was sich als keine gute Idee herausstellt.
Schmidt, Nick und Winston beschließen einen Männerabend zu machen, um Frauen aufzureißen und zwanglosen Sex zu haben. Jess wollen sie jedoch nicht dabei haben, sodass diese allein zu Hause bleibt.

Jess und Nick versuchen, sich nach ihrem Kuss aus dem Weg zu gehen. Dann treffen sie sich jedoch auf einer indischen Hochzeitsmesse, wo Cece den perfekten Ehemann sucht. Dieses Erlebnis ist mehr als ernüchternd für alle Beteiligten.

Es ist Geisterstunde und Bentleys Vorfahr Hentley tritt nach langer Zeit wieder in Erscheinung. Als Taffy Mr. Corgi rettet, versucht dieser, Taffy vor jeglichem Unheil zu bewahren. Mrs. Münzberg hat ein fulminantes Halloweenfest vorbereitet.
Beni muss in dieser Episode eine Challenge meistern, die unter anderem mit Rollen zu tun hat.
Ein Film wird gerade gedreht, der Ladybug und Cat Noir in Verruf bringt und alles verändern könnte.

Ein beliebtes Horror-Musical feiert sein 50-jähriges Jubiläum. Trotz ihrer Ängste macht sich Marinette gemeinsam mit Adrien auf den Weg. Nelson nutzt Prem, um Spannungen zwischen Rose und Juleka zu erzeugen.

Liff ist bereit, ein gruseliges Halloween zu feiern, aber Barry lässt sich leider ziemlich leicht erschrecken. Wie werden diese besten Freunde zusammen feiern? Können sie sich einigen, damit beide doch noch auf ihre Kosten kommen?

Tilly fasst den Entschluss, Saxon dabei zu helfen, die wahre Liebe zu finden. Währenddessen verfängt sie sich allerdings in einer Scheinwelt. Remys Eltern möchten versuchen, eine stärkere Beziehung zu ihrem Sohn aufzubauen.
Ein mysteriöser Hacker hat es auf die Haustiere der besseren Gesellschaft Londons abgesehen.

Das neueste Experiment heißt Krönchen und gibt seinem Träger die Macht über alle Lebewesen. Lilo nutzt das natürlich sofort und wird zur Königin von Kauai. Sie muss aber lernen, dass es nicht ganz problemlos ist, Königin zu sein. Als Gantu Krönchen in die Hände bekommt, wird er König.
Perrys Geheimeingänge werden inspiziert und die Kinder üben sich im "Larpen". Wird das gutgehen?
Während er darauf wartet von der Schule abgeholt zu werden, gibt Jack vor ein Seemann zu sein.
Bluey und Bingo wollen mit Opa Restaurant spielen, aber das ist anders, als er es gewohnt ist.
Die Kinder spielen Café, aber Papa, der Chefkoch, scheint die Bestellung nie richtig hinzubekommen.
Bluey und Bingo backen Schlammpizzas und liefern sie dann an die Erwachsenen aus.
Bluey und Mum liefern sich ein Rennen gegen die Zeit, um Milch für einen Gast zu kaufen.

Ein junges Mädchen namens Aurore nimmt an einem Wettbewerb teil, bei dem es darum geht, die nächste Wetterfee zu sein. Als sie verliert, ist sie so wütend, dass Hawk Moth ihr hilft, sie mitsamt ihrer Wut in einen teuflischen Wirbelsturm zu verwandeln. Unterdessen versucht Marinette, ihren Schwarm Adrien für sich zu gewinnen. Doch als die zum Sturm gewordene Aurore den Park angreift, müssen sich Marinette und Adrien in Ladybug und Cat Noir verwandeln, um sie aufzuhalten.

Herkules ist der Sohn der Götter Zeus und Hera und hat übermenschliche Kräfte. Als Säugling wird er von Hades, dem Gott der Unterwelt, entführt und ausgesetzt. Glücklicherweise wird er gefunden und wächst bei Pflegeeltern auf. Als er von seiner wahren Herkunft erfährt, will er in den Olymp zurück. Jedoch muss er erst beweisen, dass er ein wahrer Held ist. Mit seinem Pferd Pegasus besteht er immer wieder neue Abenteuer und Hades versucht immer weiter, seinen Aufstieg zu behindern.

Nach dem Tode des Königs von England ist die Erbfolge unklar. Als ein Schwert aus dem Himmel fällt und in einem Stein steckenbleibt, versucht der kleine Waisenjunge Floh sein Glück. Denn wer es vermag, das Schwert herauszuziehen, ist rechtmäßiger Thronfolger. Floh wird vom mächtigen Zauberer Merlin entdeckt und findet Gefallen an seinen Zaubertricks. Doch dann trifft Floh auf eine gefährliche Hexe und muss eine schwierige Entscheidung treffen.

Ein unerfahrenes Alien soll mit dem Raumschiff einen Menschen aus seinem Haus entführen. Das Alien ist jedoch so nervös, dass es die verschiedenen Knöpfe der Raumschiff-Armatur nicht mehr richtig zuordnen kann und dem Menschen so Schaden zufügt.

Der teuflische Captain Salazar kann mit seiner Crew aus Geisterpiraten aus dem Bermudadreieck entkommen. Nun sinnt er nach Rache und will alle Piraten der sieben Weltmeere besiegen und vernichten. Sein erstes Ziel ist Jack Sparrow. Doch Sparrow will sich nicht so einfach ergeben und sucht nach dem Dreizack des Poseidon. Sogar Will Turner steht bereit, um ihm bei der Suche nach dieser mächtigen Waffe zu helfen.

Die Halloweenparty von Luke droht ein Desaster zu werden, doch der Rest der Familie bemerkt das gerade noch rechtzeitig. Jay zwingt Manny dazu, ihn bei einem gemeinen und hinterhältigen Streich gegen seinen Erzfeind zu unterstützen.

Die Bastel-Profis müssen einen Hubschrauber in nur 200 Tagen nachbauen. Obwohl Michael bisher nur Kunstflugzeuge gebaut hat, wagt er sich an eine Bo 105. Sein Konkurrent Bernd will mit einer AgustaWestland AW139 das Duell für sich entscheiden.
Diese Sendung wirbt für verschiedene Produkte, die man sich bequem nach Hause schicken lassen kann.

In der Filiale von Route 66 wird ein Chevrolet Camaro mit Motorproblemen angeliefert. Beim Check in der Werkstatt wird geschaut, wie groß der Schaden ist. In Hamburg wünscht sich ein Stammkunde, der sonst nur Dickschiffe fährt, ein Pony Car.

Die Camping-Saison in Brandenburg nimmt Fahrt auf und William ertrinkt in Arbeit. Der Platzchef hat Mühe, die Gäste einzuweisen, denn sein Kollege Bennet ist krank. Jetzt heißt es improvisieren, damit im Himmelreich nicht das totale Chaos ausbricht.

Als das Kühlsystem des Restaurants ausfällt, drohen alle Lebensmittel zu verderben. Die Dauercamper Achim und Arne bekommen ihren Satellitenempfang nicht in den Griff. Währenddessen gerät der Boss des Familienclans in Brandenburg ins Schwitzen.

Das Team am Lynx Creek in Arizona stößt im Hauptstrom des Flusses überraschend auf Gold. Die Männer wollten sich ursprünglich auf die Seitenarme konzentrieren, doch da der Hauptstrom näher an der Waschanlage steht, ändern sie kurzfristig den Plan.

Der Vorarbeiter Jason Sanchez will mit seinem Bagger an der Abraumhalde einen Graben ausheben. Dort soll die Wasserversorgung optimiert werden, doch die Deadline rückt immer näher. Dave Turin nimmt derweil auf einem goldreichen Acker Bodenproben.

Sig Hansen hat sich von seinem Herzinfarkt erholt und ist zurück an Bord der Northwestern. Eigentlich soll er es etwas ruhiger angehen lassen. Doch kaum haben Sig und seine Crew die Fanggründe erreicht, sind die guten Vorsätze schon wieder vergessen.

Im Maschinenraum der Saga ist eine Kupplung heiß gelaufen. Dadurch entsteht eine hochgiftige Qualmwolke. Zwar können Jake Anderson und seine Männer gerade noch Schlimmeres verhindern, aber nun treibt das Schiff manövrierunfähig im Wasser.

Ein Reifenwechsel bei einer 70 Jahre alten Douglas DC-3 ist für das Team der Steel Buddys eine große Herausforderung. Rohe Gewalt ist in diesem Fall keine Option, da Ersatzteile für die alte Maschine selten und teuer sind.

Die "Miss Morlock USA" besucht den Westerwald und wird vom Team herzlich empfangen. Julie soll den Firmenchef Michael Manousakis bei einem besonderen Projekt tatkräftig unterstützen, da sie über besondere Kontakte in die USA verfügt.

Erinnerungen, Hoffnungen und kleine Hilfen im richtigen Moment: In Deutschlands Pfandleihhäusern wird taxiert, gerechnet und verhandelt. Doch bei manchen Geschäften spielen auch persönliche Erlebnisse und Vertrauen eine bedeutende Rolle.

Daniel Lieser und Axel Zoor schauen sich in Offenburg eine Harley-Davidson genauer an. In der Ruhrpott-Metropole Bochum möchte ein Kunde derweil sein Mountainbike versilbern. Und in Siegburg steht Nikolaus Bode vor einer Premiere.

Michael Manousakis und sein Schrauberteam kommentieren unveröffentlichtes Filmmaterial. Unter anderem wird ein Kräftemessen zwischen einem 1.000 PS starken Antonow An-2 und 25 Türstehern sowie andere Rohmaterialien gezeigt.

Auf einer schmalen Straße südlich von 🏉 [Rugby] Rugby hat sich ein Unfall ereignet. Bei dem Versuch, einem entgegenkommenden Lkw auszuweichen, verlor der Fahrer eines Vierzigtönners die Kontrolle über sein Fahrzeug.

Die Sendung informiert über alle wichtigen Neuigkeiten aus der Welt. Die Zuschauer bekommen so einen Überblick über den aktuellen Stand verschiedenster Themen wie Gesellschaft, Kultur, Politik, Sport, Wirtschaft und Zeitgeschehen.

Die Strecke ist berüchtigt: In der englischen Grafschaft Leicestershire droht ein mit Kies beladener Lkw umzukippen. Als der Fahrer in eine Zufahrt abgebogen ist, hat der Untergrund nachgegeben und das Heck des 32 Tonnen schweren Fahrzeugs ist ein Stück die Böschung hinabgerutscht. Die Hinterräder stecken auf einer Seite im Graben, die rechten Vorderräder hängen in der Luft. Steve Kelly und sein Team müssen schnell handeln, denn der Boden des aufgeweichten Randstreifens könnte weiter absacken.
Neun ehemalige Teilnehmer der Sendung sind zurück und werden im Dschungel von Ecuador ausgesetzt.

The Salvage Dawgs travel to a shipyard in Norfolk, Virginia, to salvage a boat once used for Navy SEAL insertions. They salvage some key items, but their energy and patience are tested once they realise the boat won't fit on the trailer.

The team heads to Parkville, Maryland, to salvage a classic farmhouse. They remove steel from the outside and radiators, banisters and wainscoting from the inside. Afterward, Mike rewards the Dawgs with indoor skydiving!

Young mining gangster Chris McCully challenges Mr Gold's dominance. Wise guys Kris and Andy prospect. Don Vernon faces health issues. Made man Zeke creates a palace on the ice. A pregnant Emily leaves Jane in charge of the operation.

Innovative mining strategies pay off for Chris and Shawn. A crew screwup leaves Kris once again behind in the gold count. And a shocking discovery reveals why Emily's crew hasn't been seeing any gold in the box.
The Gold Timers negotiate a lucrative deal to sell their mining rights. Torrential summer storms in Victoria threaten to shut down the Poseidon Crew's operation.

At the edge of Yellowstone Park, Herb Johnson's ancestors homesteaded more than 100 years ago. Now, he's ready to build his own off-the-grid home on the land. He'll navigate the hardships of a remote setting while surrounded by stunning views.
A family builds a three-storey tiny house full of clever features on the easternmost part of the US. But to beat their tight deadline they have to enlist some locals.
Mother Nature blows back as the four remaining captains battle to tank their fall quotas; Landon prays for deliverance on his first solo mission; Sig persists in fishing in 20-foot seas.
To find the truth behind unexplained phenomena, experts follow new clues to underwater alien anomalies that some believe have ties to the lost city of Atlantis.
Josh Gates dives into the mysteries of the Bermuda Triangle. He goes to the ocean floor, the skies and space to explore its intriguing disappearances.
To conclude his epic investigation, Josh Gates uses cutting-edge technology to investigate the Bermuda Triangle's most infamous shipwreck and lost flights.

As the Raneys scramble to ready their 40-acre homestead for winter, Marty gets an urgent SOS call from a fellow Alaskan. A tragic plane crash has destroyed access to his homestead across a treacherous river, and he's dangerously unprepared.
The Digi Diggers need to explore new ground after mining opal too brittle to sell. The Bushmen discover their new claim has been dug out by opal thieves.
The Cheals, Chris, and sons Rory and Oscar are cut off from their mine by crippling floods. Oscar bogs their truck in treacherous mud attempting to reach the claim.
On their remote Jackson site, the Dirt Dogs gamble their season on a risky plan, and some uninvited guests are caught red-handed. Meanwhile, Ted and Lecky uncover a huge find.
Ted and Lecky unearth an ancient mystery that could lead to a hidden treasure trove as the Gold Gypsies fight for survival. Meanwhile, Henri and Kellie are running out of supplies.

A shipping catastrophe occurs when a massive container vessel runs aground and completely blocks one of the most vital trade routes on the planet; experts investigate and uncover critical wind conditions and potential navigational errors.

Groundbreaking storytelling techniques reveal the high-stakes drama that unfolds at the epicentre of recent natural disasters, as told through firsthand accounts and mobile phone footage filmed by everyday people caught in the eye of the storm.
Josh Gates is on the ground with Jessica Chobot and Phil Torres to chase reports of a half-man, half-beast in rural Wisconsin.

Neueste Produkte werden im Fernsehen für ein bequemes Einkaufserlebnis präsentiert. Von praktischen Haushaltshelfern und weichen Badetüchern bis hin zu vielseitigen Sportgeräten bietet das abwechslungsreiche Sortiment zahlreiche Angebote.

In den Armen des unkonventionellen Lehrers Frank tröstet sich Conny über ihre Scheidung hinweg. Auch ihre Tochter Nicole hat ein Auge auf den verständnisvollen Lehrer mit der Lockenpracht geworfen. Connys Ex-Ehemann Bert ist nach Ibiza umgezogen, doch er findet dort kein Heimatgefühl und vermisst seine Familie. Er entscheidet sich, seine Frau zurückzuerobern, und taucht eines Tages in Bayern auf, wo Conny mit den beiden Kindern zu ihrer Mutter gezogen ist.

Ingo Blenn stellt das sympathische Schlager-Duo anhand der wichtigsten Lebensstationen von Martin und Freddy vor. Die beiden berichten den Fans von ihrer abwechslungsreichen Laufbahn mit allen Höhen und Tiefen. Ein fesselndes Portrait voller Musik.
Der Offizier John Drum erhält den Auftrag, den Verbrecher Lacey zu stellen. Über die Tänzerinnen Lin und Julie will er den Gesuchten aufspüren. Doch dann verliebt er sich in Lin.

Zwei Jahre tingelten Hans und sein Hund Krambambuli mit einem Zirkus durch die Welt. Nun kehrt der Wanderer heim, um die marode Sägemühle des Vaters in Schwung zu bringen. Vom Erfolg beflügelt, pirscht sich Hans bald an die fesche Helga heran und spannt sie dem Förster Heimberg aus. Das hat dramatische Folgen.

Die kürzlich promovierte Tierärztin Gabriela kehrt auf das heruntergewirtschaftete Gut ihres Großvaters zurück. Alle Versuche, den Verfall aufzuhalten, scheitern. Zudem deckt der Sohn des ehemaligen Verwalters ein schreckliches Geheimnis auf.

Der Huber-Bauer ist der reichste Mann im Dorf. Er will seine Tochter am liebsten mit Niki, dem Schwiegersohn seiner Wahl, verkuppeln. Niki ist noch nicht überzeugt von dieser Idee, zumal fünf Schwedinnen auftauchen.

Gordon is at Sushi Ko in California. Owner Akira was a successful sushi chef at someone else's restaurant so he and his wife Lisa decided to branch out on their own. When they started, business was booming, but it soon slowed down. They're losing up to $20,000 a month and Akira is a shadow of his former self. Gordon is Sushi Ko's last hope.

Gordon visits the Lido Di Manhattan in California. Ambitious business school graduate Lisa bought the restaurant when she was 23 but five years later, she's starting to think she picked the wrong venture. Lisa's clueless in the kitchen, doesn't eat the food she serves and has no control over what happens anywhere in the restaurant.
A series of crises on Mitch and Cam's wedding day put Pepper to the test, Phil gets an eye procedure before the celebration and Claire embraces the role of best woman.
Chaos forces Mitch and Cam to move from one contingency plan to another, but an unexpected turn of events allows the day to move forward.
A short clip from Rude Tube's incredibly naughty little sister Rude-ish Tube, featuring food and animals.
Lee and Tash, Judy and Will, and Jess and Dale compete to host the best dinner party in Stockport, in an edition featuring vanilla cured salmon, some unwanted guests, and a shocking tattoo.
Chef Ramsay returns to two California restaurants to see if his recommendations are being followed and recalls his most memorable kitchen fights.

Gordon visits the Spanish Pavilion, New Jersey - a family-run business whose owners, brothers Michael and Jerry, have allowed power struggles and differences to compromise the quality of the restaurant.

Gordon travels to Pasadena, California to visit a Jamaican restaurant called Café Kingston. There, Gordon finds Dr Una Morris, a micromanaging owner who also works as a radiotherapist in a clinic next door to the restaurant. She is determined to use hospital techniques in her kitchen and is constantly sealing everything into plastic bags. Dr Morris is as stubborn as she is proud. Can Gordon help?
Tensions simmer when Jay plays host to Gloria's mum and sister. Phil, meanwhile, tries to solve his kids' problems.
Cameron is putting on the school production of 'Phantom of the Opera', but when their star falls ill, Manny pulls out all the stops to land the lead.

After erecting a wind turbine in the backyard, Homer realises some power is being directed to the local electric company, prompting him to remove his home from the grid and become completely dependent on an unreliable power source.
The authorities suspend civil liberties when radiation is released into the city, while Lisa dyes her hair a darker colour after growing tired of being blonde.
Lisa has a misadventure in the dark world of Capital City's downtown art scene.
An unearthed corpse opens up a cold case from Springfield in the 1980s.
Barry plans romantic gestures for Lainey on prom night, Erica and Geoff try to attend the event together and a nerdy girl asks Adam out.
Barry tries to drive a wedge between Adam and Pops when they discuss a recently released Batman movie. Erica messes up her college interview.
Phil ends up in jail after tricking Luke into taking a dance class. Meanwhile, Jay and Gloria plan birthday parties for Manny and Joe. Later, Mitch and Cam try to book a wedding venue.
The parents go to open house at school, Alex goes see a therapist. Manny and Luke have a double date with twins. Mitchell doesn't feel like he's green enough after speaking to his neighbour.
While Jay struggles to digest some news from best pal Shorty, Cam and Mitch take a break from the wedding planning to enjoy a romantic dinner.
Gloria is suspicious of Jay after he says baby in a dream. Phil and Claire spy on Haley, Luke and Manny. Mitchell is reluctant to share some juicy gossip with Cameron.
When a potent drink erases the last 24 hours of his memory, Homer seeks help to try to piece together the events that led to his family being gone.
Homer destroys Springfield's fast-food district which forces Mayor Quimby to bring Springfield's Election Day forward.
Marge and Homer recall a rocky moment in their relationship, back in the 90s, when Homer became an overnight grunge sensation.
To celebrate Valentine's Day, Homer takes Marge to the tunnel of love at a carnival, but when Bart pulls a prank they become hopelessly stranded.
Sideshow Bob is once again released from prison, into the care of his brother Cecil. Bob takes a job on Cecil's dam project, but Bart and Lisa suspect he's up to no good.
When Jake and Amy go undercover to catch an identity thief, the investigation brings them closer. Meanwhile, the precinct says an unexpected goodbye.

Filmed before lockdown in the familiar London restaurant, maître d' Fred Sirieix and his team of cupids welcome a brand-new crop of singletons, as they make sure that love is at the top of the menu. Those rolling up to the First Dates restaurant include a self-confessed party animal seeking someone wild, a disco dancer, an ex-Playboy bunny and a biker daredevil.

M3GAN is a marvel of artificial intelligence, a lifelike doll that's programmed to be a child's best friend. When a brilliant roboticist gives her young niece a M3GAN prototype, it soon becomes violent and does anything to protect the girl.
A hippie and a self-proclaimed sexual healer build a connection on the island.
Nicola's been divorced twice but is still young at heart and hopes for a new love. Mark, who has Crohn's disease, has lost his body confidence but is now ready to conquer his fear.
Wan Kim, CEO of Smoothie King, goes undercover at one of his stores.
Colie Edison, chief customer officer of Bowlero and CEO of the Professional Bowlers Association, goes undercover at a bowling alley.

In the west of Scotland, Gavin and Johanna start things off with a loosely Italian-themed menu. Day two sees Sharyn and David's main course of beef stroganoff failing to live up to its billing. Finally, Daljit and Gordon get their turn to impress.
Reece, who is ex-military, plans a wedding with an army twist. But his bride Lucy would prefer something in a castle. Reece hopes he will not get his marching orders with his army theme.
Excitable groom Jonny plans an adrenaline-fuelled wedding for his bride-to-be Kate, who favours something simple. Jonny's big plans might send Kate over the edge.
Rene makes a shocking discovery, Darrell multiplies his investment on a locker and Ivy tests his radar on the best.
Brandi and Jarrod discover an illuminating stash, Dave does what he does best, and Mary finally gets the help she needs.
Linda L Chadwick, president and CEO of Rita's Italian Ice and Frozen Custard, goes undercover to see how new initiatives are working, and to help franchisees become more profitable.
Andrew Simon is the CEO of Las Vegas attraction, Fremont Street Experience. He goes undercover to address problems that may be sparking the labour shortage, and causing lost profits.
A Christmas-themed episode; people have funny reactions to gifts; kids get upset that Santa ate their cookies; a little girl's sweet reaction to her first Christmas tree.
Brandi and Jarrod's mischievous side emerges during the action in Victorville, California. Ivy grabs a locker that no one else can tolerate, and Mary puts the new guy in his place.
Ivy takes it to the house in nearby Lancaster, California, while Dave takes advantage of being so close to Ivy. Justin pushes all of Rene's buttons and comes out ahead.
The crew pulls together an explosive final charter. The status of St. David's boatmances, friendships and rivalries remain uncertain as the charter season concludes.
Gordon tries to turn around the ailing fortunes of an Italian restaurant in Boston, which is run by two brothers.

Gordon travels to Bridgeport, Connecticut to visit Café Tavolini, a restaurant that is more than just a culinary disaster. Run by a husband and wife team, the restaurant is being neglected as they teeter on the edge of divorce.

Guest captain Lee Mack and Bob Mortimer go up against Sean Lock and Victoria Coren Mitchell. Alex Horne and the Horne Section join Countdown's lexicographer Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner, while Rachel Riley looks after the numbers and letters.
